description: High Tables, Red Dragon: prepare (unsigned) taking a seat at a table (an approve of the stake, then join). Needs an Override Disk in the wallet. When the sixth seat fills the table is sealed to a public drand draw; the Dragon's seat takes 95% of the pot.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_red_dragon_join
